$schema_comment: This is a project-specific policy draft, not a clang-tidy native configuration.
basis: cpp_TKG.zip source patterns with user-requested overrides

variables.pointers: p (overrides the underlying value type prefix); pointer-to-pointer pp
variables.const_ref: same prefix as value of referenced type; no automatic r prefix
variables.mutable_ref: allow r prefix as legacy but do not require
variables.const_variable: same as normal typed variable, not a named constant
variables.string_view: permit no prefix or s, to preserve existing examples

legacy_semantic_constant.condition: must be explicitly allowlisted AND constexpr must be impossible

checks.constexpr_suggestion: Only suggest constexpr for identifiers explicitly intended as semantic constants (e.g. uppercase constant name); do not propose converting arbitrary const local variables.
checks.type_resolution: Use actual C++ AST and source-level typedef spelling for UINT/DWORD; regex alone is insufficient
checks.diagnostic: file, line, symbol, declared type, violated rule, suggested name, safe-fix availability
